item.title: Henry Cejudo Retires From MMA
item.description: Henry Cejudo is calling it a career. Following his loss at UFC 323 to Payton Talbott, Cejudo announced his retirement. Cejudo lost the bout by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 30-27). After the fight, Cejudo told Dana White, “It’s time. That just showed it.” Dana said that Cejudo fought with a lot of heart.
